verdict.rationale: Reducto bills itself as an agentic document platform with Studio workflows and agentic parse modes, so letting it consume external MCP tools is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence only shows Reducto acting as an MCP server that other MCP clients connect to. That is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story, and nothing shows Reducto itself connecting to or using MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
